description: Ten-image furniture-understanding benchmark with one photograph from each distinct furniture collection. The studio folder was excluded because its images duplicate other collections. Ettrick annotations were retrospective; subsequent cases were annotated before model inference. All annotations remain provisional until adjudicated.
